mapper.select: SELECT MAX(ORDER_ID) FROM ORDER_TB WHERE ORDER_ID LIKE 'M%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_TB ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_ID, APPLICANT_KEY, NAME, ADDRESS, ITEM_NAME, PRICE, STATUS, COMPANY_CHECK_COLUMN ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{applicantKey}, #{name}, #{address}, #{itemName}, #{price}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, ITEM_ID, APPLICANT_KEY, NAME, ADDRESS, ITEM_NAME, PRICE, STATUS FROM ORDER_TB WHERE STATUS = 'N' AND APPLICANT_KEY = #{applicantKey}
